name: Tori Staked trUSD
oneLiner: strUSD is Tori's trUSD savings vault, accruing trading rewards and returning trUSD after a seven-day cooldown.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum StakedTrUSD is a transferable ERC-4626 operational share claim against trUSD held in 0x280839980a7ed0d7717f64125fe241012e5f5815. Monad and Pharos are CCIP representations backed by the Ethereum escrow, not independent vaults or additional native liabilities. Local share accounting and cooldown differ from the parent synthetic-dollar mechanism.

collateral: trUSD held by the Ethereum staking vault; unvested rewards are excluded from totalAssets. Burned cooldown claims hold trUSD in the separate silo. Offchain reserve and strategy risks remain with tracked trUSD.
pegMechanism: Holders stake trUSD for ERC-4626 shares. Current cooldownDuration is 604800 seconds: cooldownShares or cooldownAssets burns shares and moves trUSD to the silo, then unstake releases it. Staking and unstaking carry no protocol fee; gas applies. Restricted addresses can be blocked and their shares or cooldown funds seized. Parent trUSD repurchase is a separate KYC-approved, discretionary issuer route.
